NEXUS · MUSIC
Nexus  ·  The Stage  ·  San Diego

The Artists
Who Shaped
The Stage

Every artist who has performed at Nexus has brought something unrepeatable to the room — their sound, their world, their truth. This is where their work lives on and continues to grow.

NEBTUNES✦ SWANI LOVE✦ NAJEE BENAE✦ NINA LIM✦ VILLAGE THEORY✦ KATRIZ TRINIDAD✦ NICOLE HERNANDEZ✦ RHONDA GLEZ✦ NEBTUNES✦ SWANI LOVE✦ NAJEE BENAE✦ NINA LIM✦ VILLAGE THEORY✦ KATRIZ TRINIDAD✦ NICOLE HERNANDEZ✦ RHONDA GLEZ✦
— The Artists  ·  Nexus Stage
01
NEBTUNES
DJ · Producer · Curator

Nebtunes' eclectic musical choices aid her in the high impact experiences she crafts. Whether it be behind the switchboard, conducting an all women jazz ensemble, nurturing spaces for emerging talent to grow, or performing a fusion of sounds around beautiful spaces — the world she creates engulfs.

@nebulawade Linktree
02
SWANI LOVE
Poetry · Movement · Creative

Swani Love creates melodic and introspective poems that wrap you in a message of authenticity and perspective. As a multi faceted creative, Swani loves all things creative from dancing with fire to writing poetry that heals through vision.

@swaniloves Website
03
NAJEE BENAE
Music · R&B · Soul · Creative

Najee Benae has a vocal presence that completely captivates with the richness of her tone and the gracefulness of her placement. As an all around creative, Najee's interests expand out to the vastness of media, fashion, and all things culture. You can catch her Soulful Tuesdays at her Louisiana Purchase residency.

@najeebenae Linktree
04
NINA LIM
Multi-Instrumentalist · Vocalist · Violinist

As a multi instrumentalist and performance class act, Nina captivates you in an immersive experience that will leave you in wonder and awe. Her many disciplines expand onto her original work. Her vocals effortlessly float above the very drums she's playing, oftentimes simultaneously while also switching onto the violin. Check out her latest single “Slow” ft. n3w m00n — out now on all platforms.

@ninalimmusic TikTok Spotify
05
VILLAGE THEORY
Global Folk Fusion · World Music

Village Theory is a global folk fusion band drawing inspiration from traditional folk music across Asia, Africa, Latin America, and the Middle East. Specialized in non-western instruments, their instrumentation, lyrics, and composition sonically explore themes of devotion, connection, tradition, and altered states of consciousness. This is an experience that expands past what can be imagined.

@villagetheoryband
06
KATRIZ TRINIDAD
Music · R&B · Soul · Alt

Katriz Trinidad has a vocal essence that wraps you in the warmth of her smooth, buttery vocals and engulfs you in the totality of the conceptual universes she creates. Her original work can be found on all platforms under the name of Katriz Trinidad. Check out her latest single “Bleached Brows.”

@itskatriztrinidad TikTok Spotify Linktree
07
NICOLE HERNANDEZ
Artist · Creative Entrepreneur · Golfer · Founder

Nicole Hernandez is a multi disciplinary artist, creative entrepreneur, and golfer that is looking to expand and push culture through intersectionality. Her love for many things is what pushed her to create Nexus as she sees everything oftentimes connecting to one another, rather than not. Her debut album Layers and the accompanying short film, Layered Visions, is a fusion of Afro-Cuban R&B.

Instagram TikTok YouTube Linktree
08
RHONDA GLEZ
Music · R&B · Hip-Hop · Techno · Multi-Genre

Rhonda Glez is a Tijuana-based artist who moves fluidly between R&B, hip-hop, techno, and more. A true believer that expression knows no boundaries — for her, versatility isn't just a choice, it's part of who she is: creating and singing across different styles to connect with all kinds of emotions. In November 2024 she released her debut album Sazón — a seven-track project produced in Tijuana. The title comes from her journey across different stages, performing all kinds of genres just to enjoy music and share it with people. Sazón is that special touch that defines her: a free sound.

@rhondaglez TikTok Spotify Linktree
09
VIVI NUBES
Singer · Songwriter · Flutist · San Diego

Vivi Nubes is a singer, songwriter, and musician born and raised in San Diego, CA. Her musical journey began as a child singing in choirs and learning to play the flute. Since then her passion for music has only grown — she now composes her own music, and each song carries a message, a feeling, and love woven into it. Her upcoming single Miss Mary drops May 22, 2026.

@vivinubes Spotify Mixtape Bundle
10
FRE3STY13
Vocalist · Songwriter · San Diego · Community

YV is a San Diego songstress and mother who graduated from SD School of Creative & Performing Arts and holds a Bachelor's of Arts from SDSU with an emphasis in performance. She's been singing across various disciplines for over two decades. Under the name Fre3sty13, her music acknowledges vocal freedom to express the sound of breath — a lifestyle and music ministry dedicated to reconciling and rehabilitating all beings to our true internal nature, nurtured on the streets of San Diego. Her presence is a divine demonstration of effective community engagement. Check out “I Have Words 2 Say (Interlude)” and her new song Interdependent Harmony on all streaming platforms.

@fre3sty13 Spotify Bandcamp Linktree YouTube
11
DELEON NOX
Music · R&B · Soul · Vocal

Deleon Nox's vocal agility and soulful melodies pull you deep into the beauty of his artistic essence. Don't miss his latest EP Toxic — out now on all platforms. Watch the music video for “This Is How We Do” on Beazie Beats' YouTube channel.

@deleon.nox Spotify LittyLink Linktree
12
SARAYU
Singer · Songwriter · R&B · Soul · Carnatic · Hindustani

Sarayu is a singer-songwriter born and raised in New Jersey. Influenced by R&B and soul as well as the classical traditions of Carnatic and Hindustani music, her work reflects the dual identities of being a first-generation Indian American. Through this blend she creates songs that are both familiar and fresh — bridging cultures while telling stories that feel deeply personal. Her soulful voice and captivating presence will take you somewhere beautiful. Stream her latest EP With Love now.

@sarayu Spotify Linktree
13
KALIA SOL
Singer · Songwriter · Jazz · Neo-Soul · Caribbean

Kalia Sol is an artist and creative from Miami, now based in San Diego. Since 2018 she has been on a journey of expressing herself through music — blending jazz, neo-soul, and Caribbean influences rooted in her Dominican heritage. She fuses English and Spanish in her lyrics and is beginning to explore Portuguese as well. Alongside creating, she has studied audio engineering, production, and live sound to shape her art with intention, and continues learning bass, piano, and ukulele while deepening her music theory and songwriting. Her stunning vocal tone and captivating range draw you into a melodic world uniquely her own. Stream her latest EP Colores now on all platforms.

@kaliasolmusic Spotify TikTok
14
SAXSOULJAH
Multi-Instrumentalist · Jazz · Gospel · R&B · Educator

Jabari Hutchins — known as Saxsouljah — is a 24-year-old powerhouse whose roots run deep in jazz, gospel, and R&B. Born and raised in San Diego, CA, Jabari is an experience you must see live. His synergy is off the charts with every artist who performs alongside him — there is no genre untouched by Saxsouljah. Across 4+ bands he graces each group with just the right touch, no matter the instrument. His breathtaking musical fluidity flows effortlessly through every note, creating compositions that captivate and move the soul. Blossoming into a musician willing to teach not because he has to, but because he truly wants to educate, Saxsouljah stays booked and busy as a recording artist, performer, educator, and friend. Stream his latest album Adam now on all platforms.

@saxsouljah Spotify

NEXUS · DANCE
Nexus  ·  Movement  ·  San Diego

The Bodies
That Moved
The Room

Dance at Nexus is not background — it is the body as instrument, as language, as protest and celebration at once. These choreographers and performers have shaped what the Nexus stage means.

THE WOO KOLLECTIVE✦ KIANA DE LA CRUZ SWAUGER✦ MOANA✦ JOFFREY BALLET SI '23✦ COMPLEXIONS SI '24✦ UCI CLAIRE TREVOR✦ SMRITHI SURESH✦ FUCHSIA DANCE✦ THE RANGERS✦ THE WOO KOLLECTIVE✦ KIANA DE LA CRUZ SWAUGER✦ MOANA✦ JOFFREY BALLET SI '23✦ COMPLEXIONS SI '24✦ UCI CLAIRE TREVOR✦
— The Dancers  ·  Nexus Stage
01
THE WOO KOLLECTIVE
Hip-Hop · Creative Direction · San Diego

Through the creative direction and leadership of Moana, The Woo Kollective has deeply impacted and shaped the culture of hip hop in San Diego. Filled with world class dancers, their high impact pieces transcend and make you feel emotions that only their rhythm and grooves captivate.

@thewookollective
02
KIANA DE LA CRUZ SWAUGER
Ballet · Contemporary · Dance Theater · UCI Arts

Kiana's beautiful agility and effortless movement blend her expression through deep intention and love. As a trained dancer with experience from the Joffrey Ballet SI '23 and Complexions SI '24, Kiana continues to master her craft at the UCI Claire Trevor School of the Arts, class of 2029.

@kiki_aahh
03
SMRITHI SURESH
Bharatanatyam · Indian Classical · Choreographer · San Diego

Smrithi Suresh has trained in Bharatanatyam for 18 years — a lifelong love that began with a single step learned from her aunt. She has studied under Gurus Smt. Suganda Sreenath, Smt. Shreya Iyer of Jayendra Kalenkendra, and later Smt. Radhika Karandikar in San Diego. The form has taken her to stages in Dallas, the Bay Area, Cleveland, New York, and India, and earned her recognition as an IndianRaga Fellow and performer at TedXBerkeley and the Erasing Borders Dance Festival. Dance, for Smrithi, is both a bridge to her cultural heritage and a connection to all art forms and people. In 2021 she co-founded Fuchsia Dance — a space for Indian classical dancers to collaborate and push the boundaries of tradition. Most recently she participated in the inaugural AADF dance residency in Oceanside.

@smrithi.sur @fuchsiadance fuchsiadance.org
04
THE RANGERS
Hip-Hop · Street · Collective · Multi-Studio

The Rangers are a group of individuals from many places — coming together from Culture Shock, Studio FX, Syde FX, 220 Family, high schools, and the LA industry. Their goal is to spread the overwhelming feeling of love for dance and artistry.

The Members
@slayin_eien @annah0ang @_zanianna @yagurltimiya @moollays @briiannachau

Nexus Fashion Show · Casting · 2026

Model
Casting

Nexus Fashion Show is casting for our 2026 runway. We are looking for people who embody the intersection — artists, athletes, and creatives who carry something in the room that can't be manufactured.

Who We're Looking For
All genders, body types, and backgrounds. Nexus Fashion is not about one vision of beauty — it's the full spectrum of what makes a person compelling.
What to Expect
Selected models walk the Nexus runway, appear in original editorial content, and join the Nexus creative archive.
Location & Date
Location to be announced. Follow @n3xus.now for venue reveal, casting call dates, and show details.
Experience
Prior experience welcome but not required. We value presence, confidence, and the ability to inhabit a look and a moment.

The Nexus Golf Tournament  ·  2026

Where
Culture
Meets the Course

The Nexus Golf Tournament is not a golf tournament. It is a convergence — a single day where the world's most compelling figures from music, film, sports, and fashion step onto the green and compete. Think The Masters in its discipline. Think the Met Gala in its spectacle. Think nothing you have ever seen before.

2026
Inaugural Season
San Diego
California
By Invite
Exclusive Access
"The most elegant intersection of sport, culture, and art the world has seen since the first Masters."
The Nexus Standard  ·  Our Vision
01
Celebrity Field
Participants drawn from the upper echelons of music, film, athletics, and fashion — names the world already knows, competing together for the first time.
02
Curated Experience
Every detail — from the caddie program to the evening reception — is designed with the precision of a Chanel runway and the intimacy of an exclusive dinner.
03
Live Performance
The course comes alive. Musical performances, art installations, and film projections at select holes blur the line between sport and spectacle.
04
Black Tie Evening
The round closes with a formal reception — cocktails, awards, and an evening program that rivals any gala on the social calendar.

Location to be announced. Invitations by selection only. Follow @n3xus.now for updates.

Get Involved  ·  2026

Take Your
Position

The Nexus Golf Tournament is built by people who believe in what it represents. Whether you want to play, volunteer, perform, or partner — there's a role for you.

01
Play in the Tournament
Express interest in participating as a player. We welcome athletes, artists, and cultural figures who bring something to the field.
02
Perform at the Event
The course is a stage. Musicians and performers are placed at signature holes — apply to bring your art to the green.
03
Volunteer
Be part of the Nexus ground crew — from course setup to guest experience, we need people who care about doing it right.
04
Media & Press
Credentialed press, photographers, and filmmakers — apply for media access and coverage opportunities.

Tell us who you are and how you'd like to be involved. We'll be in touch.

Learn by
Building

We are building the Nexus Golf Tournament from the ground up — which means we need hungry, talented people who want to do real work on a real event. These are not coffee-fetching internships.

Event Operations
Tournament Operations Intern
Course logistics, player coordination, day-of execution. You will know this event inside out.
Partnerships

Research, outreach, and relationship management with luxury and lifestyle brands.
Creative

Media
